title: Total correctness of source field inversion
preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_BinaryRuntime

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
open NKtLB
formal_statement:
theorem ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse_stops {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 31 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r) (inp : Inputs)
    (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (a : Fin (2^ell)) (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j,d.reg j ≤ M) (hs : ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.InverseSetup r ell h a d) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ 20000*(M+1)^7 ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse (B:=B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverseResult r d ∧ e.reg (r 27) = (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryField.inverseIndex ell h a).val ∧
      (∀ i,i = 0 ∨ i = 3 ∨ i = 19 ∨ i = 23 ∨ i = 24 → e.reg (r i) = d.reg (r i)) ∧
      (∀ j,(∀ i,j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧ (∀ j,e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d := by sorry
natural_statement: The explicit finite tape program for inversion in a binary extension field computes the canonical inverse index, including inverse zero equal to zero. It halts within the stated polynomial bound and preserves the designated caller registers and tape payload.
source: Algorithmic supporting lemma for Section 2 of Isaac M Hair and Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch; the explicit tape-machine implementation is formalized in ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.
proof_route: The proof handles nonzero inversion by a bounded search with a unique successful candidate and separately proves the total zero case.
solution_header:
theorem solution {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 31 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r) (inp : Inputs)
    (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (a : Fin (2^ell)) (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j,d.reg j ≤ M) (hs : ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.InverseSetup r ell h a d) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ 20000*(M+1)^7 ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse (B:=B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverseResult r d ∧ e.reg (r 27) = (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryField.inverseIndex ell h a).val ∧
      (∀ i,i = 0 ∨ i = 3 ∨ i = 19 ∨ i = 23 ∨ i = 24 → e.reg (r i) = d.reg (r i)) ∧
      (∀ j,(∀ i,j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧ (∀ j,e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d
solution_body:
by
  exact @ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.inverse_stops R B r hr inp ell h a M hM d hd hs
